profile.headline: Digital Configuration Management - Sr. Software Engineer at Baker Hughes
profile.jobTitle: Digital Configuration Management - Sr. Software Engineer

positions.title: Digital Configuration Management - Sr. Software Engineer
Senior Application Operations Engineer
positions.description: Provide team leadership to a specialized software development team through the development of various systems and projects to meet business initiative in the Inquiry to Order (ITO) and Order to Remittance (OTR) space.  Responsible for merging Product, Engineering, Science, and manufacturing disciplines into one cohesive set of quotation tools for Valves, Levels, and Regulator for Masoneilan, Becker, Consolidated and Mooney products.  Creation of various integration mechanisms to ERP and Downstream business systems.  Development of Centralized quotation storage and analytics.  Creation and development of industry first Control Valve AI (Application Intelligence) expert system.  Heavy interaction and diplomacy with customers and business leadership while supporting a 4000+ end user base.

positions.title: Manager Systems and Projects
positions.description: Managed a Team of 4 specialized direct report developers and 10 off-shore resource in the Inquiry to Order (ITO) software development space.  Developed and Maintained the Quotation tools and provided training to Sales Channel and Customers worldwide.  Implemented and maintained various systems that combined Product, Engineering Science, and manufacturing requirements into the quotation tools for Masoneilan and Consolidated.  Coordinated with business leadership on Market share objectives using the quotation tool as a key business differentiator.  Held performance reviews for in-shore team members as well as yearly in-person performance reviews with key off-shore vendors in India.

positions.title: Development Team Leader
positions.description: Formed and developed specialized team to salvage a 6 million dollar project to implement a global quotation tool for the Masoneilan brand.  Original project used a third party framework which was dropped due to non-performance and technical gaps.  Lead the development of the Global quotation tool known as "ValSpeQ" based on Microsoft Technology stack for windows.  Resulting software still in use today providing technology and value for the quotation process worldwide.  Enhanced tool in a modular and phased approach throughout in order to meet ever changing gloable expectations (fast works).  Accelerated pace to recover original project cost was managed with intense team workouts and heavy sales channel and customer interaction.  Team was also used in various embedded software development projects for the new generation digital products being developed at the time and was pulled into the Advance Research and Development division by the manager.

positions.title: Senior Software Analyst
positions.description: Maintain and develop ERP and Financial software systems on the Hewlett Packard mainframe as part of a 10 person IT Team.  IT Team at the time also managed and maintained phones, fax, and other pre-digital telecommunication systems.  Switch legacy ERP systems to new generation GrowthPower systems and assisted in rebuilding the business information infrastructure.  Support business analyst by implementing, testing and deploying specified business systems in 4th generation languages (Cognos, etc).  Support Global workforce in all business functions from order entry through remittance.  Developed business reports and analytics visuals and processes for senior management.
